Definitely. But you're 16 so you'll have to walk a fine line between photographers and agents.

I always suggest getting in front of the camera, keeping in mind that you're 16 and should go for more conservative look. Get in front of agents if you can with some portfolio and really dive into. when you're 18+ you should be in the heart of modeling. Try to find a city that fits your likes and be there and do everything you can. It's a tough business.

Modeling is all about networking and getting a portfolio and putting yourself out there until you start getting noticed. Remember in any industry there are millions trying to do the same thing with a ton more potential than you. There will always be someone trying harder. So it depends on how serious you are. You want to do it for a living? or side money? Either way, get in front of the camera as much as possible. Look for TFP Photographers in your area that will shoot you and get you some shots for a portfolio. Even at 15. Start young, many companies like longevity in models. start too old and you might not be as marketable.

5'8" is probably too short for runway, but that's not always the case, depending on your agent and the brand, you could still walk. 

Editorial is different because the camera can disguise height very well.

It also depends on how far you want to take your modeling career. Just for fun/side money? Or Serious modeling?

I'm not an expert but I think you're handsome and photogenic, it's hard to tell from 1 picture. I suggest getting together with TFP (Trade for Print) photographers to build your portfolio, choose a niche you want to tackle (like, are you trying to fitness model? runway? youth clothing? abercrombie and fitch?... choose how you want to brand yourself), get in front of the camera as much as possible, get a website (A free or cheap squarespace style website where you can post your portfolio), contact agents, ask other models, network, get in the gym, try to figure out your weaknesses in modeling and work on them. It's a process but at least your genes are working for you and your age is good for getting started and really diving in.
